issues.description: Raw Udemy Courses dataset file is missing from the local workspace.
issues.evidence: No CSV files found in the datasets directory.
issues.impact: Prevents preprocessing, training, and model serialization.
issues.proposedFix: Download the Udemy dataset from Kaggle and place it in the datasets/raw folder.

issues.description: Training and comparison notebooks exist as stubs and have not been executed.
issues.evidence: Empty output cells in jupyter notebook json schemas.
issues.impact: No binary model files are compiled or exported for FastAPI loading.
issues.proposedFix: Execute notebooks 01 through 07 sequentially once the dataset is resolved.

issues.description: Binary model weight artifacts (classifier.joblib, tfidf_vectorizer.joblib) do not exist.
issues.impact: FastAPI will startup in degraded mode only.

issues.evidence: Placeholder hashes in checksum mapping file.
issues.proposedFix: Compute sha256 checksums of trained model binaries and save to checksums.json.

issues.description: Stripe test keys and database passwords are committed in config files.
issues.impact: Minor security risk, tracked in general risk analysis log.
issues.proposedFix: Relocate config secrets to environment variables in Phase 10.
